shared_elements: curvilinear/rounded painted or carved motifs on a broad surface
justification: A shows only faint, largely amorphous reddish patches and vague rounded blobs on a low plastered bench-like wall, with no legible figures or signs; B shows a dense, deliberately composed field of interlocking scroll and volute motifs forming a stylised face or mask-like design filling a rounded slab. The only shared trait is that both surfaces bear rounded, curvilinear marks spread across a broad face, which is far too generic to suggest any shared iconographic scheme; B's tightly organised, bilaterally structured glyph-like relief has no counterpart in A.
